verdict.rationale: Autumn's docs show a client library in use (`autumn.check(...)`, `autumn.track(...)`, a documented `check` method) and an AI SDK integration that auto-tracks token usage for `generateText`/`streamText` calls. This implies official client SDKs, but the pack never names the SDK packages, the supported languages or their versioning. Missing for 10: explicit official SDK package/language listing, SDK reference docs beyond snippets, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: const response = await autumn.check({ customerId: "user_123", featureId: "messages" });
The `check` method returns the `allowed` field in real-time to check if a customer should have access to a feature.
automatically tracking token usage for every `generateText` or `streamText` call. No manual `trackTokens` calls needed.
